answer: The design leans on retroactive public goods funding mechanisms. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Written in a economic framing, incentive alignment focus register, it stays short. Reaching the ocean of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Work waits on the cedar until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the saffron of the next round.
